emailAutomationActivationActivateFailed: The automation couldn't be activated. Try again.
emailAutomationActivationArchiveDescript: Archiving ends all runs, including those still waiting, and no more emails are sent. This can't be undone.
emailAutomationActivationArchiveFailed: The automation couldn't be archived. Try again.
emailAutomationActivationArchived: This automation is archived and can no longer be activated.
emailAutomationActivationDryRunFailed: The dry run couldn't start. Try again.
emailAutomationActivationEntrantsTitle: Who would enter at the next fire, {fire}
emailAutomationActivationExplainReplay: A dry run replays the last 30 days of trigger events on the current working copy and shows who would have been sent the email, and when. Nothing is sent.
emailAutomationActivationExplainSchedule: A dry run shows who would enter at the next scheduled fire and which of them pass the conditions now. Nothing is sent.
emailAutomationActivationFailureArchived: This automation is archived and can no longer change.
emailAutomationActivationFailureAudience: The campaign's audience is archived. Choose an active audience, then try again.
emailAutomationActivationFailureDraftCha: The working copy or the audience changed after the dry run. Run the dry run again, then activate.
emailAutomationActivationFailureFallback: Add the Czech email. Customers whose language has no email of its own receive the Czech one.
emailAutomationActivationFailureFlowInva: The flow isn't complete yet. Finish it on the Flow tab, then try again.
emailAutomationActivationFailurePreviewR: Run a dry run of the current working copy before activating.
emailAutomationActivationFailureStatusCo: The automation's state changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
emailAutomationActivationFlagApproximate: A reservation status this depends on changed in a way that can't be dated, so the outcome may have been different at the time.
emailAutomationActivationFlagProjectedHi: This is evaluated after now, from the customer's facts as they are now, so it can still change.
emailAutomationActivationJobFailedReason: Something went wrong while it evaluated customers. Run it again.
emailAutomationActivationJobStalled: It made no progress for over an hour. Run it again.
emailAutomationActivationJobSuperseded: The working copy changed while the dry run was running, so its results no longer apply. Run it again.
emailAutomationActivationNoEntrants: Nobody would enter at the next fire.
emailAutomationActivationNoReplayRows: No trigger events happened in the last 30 days.
emailAutomationActivationPauseFailed: The automation couldn't be paused. Try again.
emailAutomationActivationPauseHint: No new runs start and waiting runs stop advancing until you resume.
emailAutomationActivationPausedNotice: Paused since {date}. No new runs start and waiting runs don't advance; on resume, overdue delays proceed at once and waits and conditions are re-checked.
emailAutomationActivationProfileFactsCur: Conditions on tags, discount group, language and consent used each customer's current profile, not the profile at the time of the event.
emailAutomationActivationPublished: The live version already matches the working copy. There is nothing to publish.
emailAutomationActivationReady: The dry run of the current working copy has finished. Review the results below, then activate the automation.
emailAutomationActivationReadyChanges: The dry run of the current working copy has finished. Review the results below, then publish the changes.
emailAutomationActivationReplayScope: Replayed the trigger events of the 30 days before {asOf}.
emailAutomationActivationRequired: Activation needs a finished dry run of the current working copy.
emailAutomationActivationResumeFailed: The automation couldn't be resumed. Try again.
emailAutomationActivationResumeHint: Runs continue. Overdue delays proceed at once; waits and conditions are checked again.
emailAutomationActivationRunning: The dry run is running. This page updates on its own.
emailAutomationActivationTruncated: {total} events happened in the last 30 days. The dry run replayed the latest 1,000 of them.
